data.summary: Whenever this model is chosen to fight, pick one option that applies while its attacks are resolved. Direct Grace: Fidelity gains **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)**. Forceful Strike: Fidelity gains **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)**. Whirling Stance: Fidelity has **[[SUSTAINED HITS 2]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** in place of **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.
